summary: Expose persisted parent-email to selected-attachment provenance in the existing analysis-run workflow view without inheriting semantic authority, approval or workflow role.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and email content
Existing rule that imported email attachments remain explicit, inert and human-reviewed
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes broader RFI, Submittal and email support with continued efficiency and accuracy improvement.
known_limitations: The relationship records an explicit local import only and does not infer RFI/Submittal role, approval, authority or semantic meaning.
Only source and attachment documents present in the same analysis run appear in its workflow view.
MSG, mailbox synchronization, automatic recursive attachment import and semantic thread inference remain unsupported.
Validation uses synthetic local files only and makes no model or external provider request.
